headline: Endpoints News asks why an AI scribe, a tool that writes up doctors' visit notes, wants to take on prescribing.
score_reason: Pool score 5, lowered by 1: the article is behind a paywall and only its opening line is known.
importance_line: Doctors, health systems and the makers of AI note-taking tools are the people affected, but what the AI scribe would prescribe, who is behind it and what safeguards apply are not known from the opening line.
summary: Endpoints News reports that health tech companies have been racing to grow AI scribing tools, which write up doctors' visits, into software that health systems can use more broadly, and asks why an AI scribe now wants to prescribe.
notes: Endpoints News is paywalled; only the opening line is visible ('Health tech companies have been racing to grow AI scribing tools into software that health systems can use more broadly ...'). No other outlet carries it. The text does not name the company, and no link to the Suki funding story of the same day is stated, so none is made. Headline only.
